data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error in the qwen model (HTTP 400 BadRequestError when auditing PKGBUILD), not by substantive disagreement about the package's safety. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit PKGBUILD due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: When a model fails due to a tool error (API crash, timeout, etc.), the audit system should not propagate that failure to the final verdict if other models successfully completed the audit
Implement retry logic or fallback models when API errors occur during critical file audits
